planets.name: Kepler-1024 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-1024 with a 66.4-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: Kepler-1024 b crosses its star every 66.4 days and is 0.35 times as wide as Jupiter, found in 2016.
text.introduction: Kepler-1024 b transits Kepler-1024 every 66.4 days and is 0.35 times as wide as Jupiter. Orbit and size follow Morton et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname MORTON_ET_AL__2016): pl_orbper 66.4162133, pl_radj 0.34882684, pl_bmassj 0.0457
